logp.method_description: The compound (80 μM) in 0.5 mL octanol was subjected to partition with 0.5 mL octanol-saturated PBS (pH 7.4). The resulting mixture was stirred vigorously for 5 min, and centrifuged at 2,000 rpm for 5 min. The octanol layer was separated from PBS layer, and its fluorescence spectrum was recorded (excited at 305 nm). The above PBS layer was partitioned with PBS-saturated octanol 0.5 mL, and the octanol layer was separated after 5 min. vigorous stirring and 5 min. centrifuge at 2,000 rpm, and its spectrum was recorded. The Log D value was calculated by the fluorescence intensity ratio at 400 nm for the above two octanol extractions
